column1: # doc-folders.tsv (harbor#1435) — the kind of a docs/ folder or file that the naming standard's kinds.tsv has no row for.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. bin/doc-shape.sh (vendored as vendor/naming/doc-shape.sh) derives a doc's `kind` from the kinds.tsv
# row whose folder holds it. This repo's docs/ predates the Diataxis folders, so each folder it has is named here
#   folder   docs/<name>/ for a folder, or a docs/ file path for one file
